record.title: microduck-m12-lens
record.why: MEASURED 2026-09-02 (lane T): the shelf's own check FAILed this folder for declaring ZERO interfaces, and that is now settled — cad/interfaces.json declares two MEASURED anchors, 'barrel' (Ø11.6000 x 7.4000 at (0.0000, 11.1000, 0.0000), the SAME nominal to 0.0000 mm as part:microduck-m12-lens-holder's Ø11.6000 bore measured independently on the other mesh) and 'body_steps' (Ø13.6000 x 3.3200 then Ø16.9400 x 5.7000), every fit at 0.0000 mm residual and 355.0 deg cover, frozen in out/laneT/features/lens.json. WHAT IS STILL MISSING, named rather than left as 'nothing measured yet': cad/part.py is still the `bin/triad new part` SKELETON and builds no geometry. And the OPTICS ARE NOT IDENTIFIED: no thread is modelled on either mesh, so the M12 x 0.5 the name implies is not measurable here (Ø11.6000 is that thread's MINOR diameter, not its major), and no focal length, aperture, format or part number appears anywhere in the reference. What settles it: a photograph of the lens barrel's markings, or Pollen's BOM.
record.origin_why: the geometry this folder describes is Pollen Robotics' own published sim asset (reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/), measured but not designed here; CC BY-SA-NC 4.0 per the pollen-robotics/microduck_rl README, so usable to assemble, render, simulate and print, NOT licensed for sale.
